description: Guide practitioners through building Einstein Next Best Action strategies using Flow Builder, configuring Recommendation records, and surfacing recommendations via the Actions & Recommendations Lightning component. Trigger keywords: next best action, NBA strategy, surface recommendations. NOT for training a custom prediction model on your own records — use agentforce/einstein-prediction-builder. NOT for Einstein Bot or Agentforce agent conversation design — use architect/einstein-bot-architecture.
inputs: Business rules defining which recommendations apply to which records or segments
Recommendation sObject records with Name, Description, ActionReference, AcceptanceLabel, and RejectionLabel
Target Lightning record page or app page where recommendations should appear
name: einstein-next-best-action
official_sources: Object Reference for the Salesforce Platform (Spring '26), Recommendation and RecommendationResponse: https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/object_reference.pdf. Supports the field list (no standard expiration field), field lengths, `IsActionActive`, and special access rules.

Metadata API Developer Guide (Spring '26), RecordActionDeployment (`maxDisplayRecommendations` 1–4, `deploymentContexts` up to 10, `shouldLaunchActionOnReject`), RecommendationStrategy, and Flow (`processType` `RecommendationStrategy`; `FlowRecordLookup` `limit`, `sortField`, `sortOrder`): https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/api_meta.pdf

Trailhead, Set Up Salesforce Flow for Service: https://trailhead.salesforce.com/content/learn/modules/service_lightning_flow_for_service/setup-lightning-flow-for-service. Supports recommendation creation steps (flow on accept), the four-recommendation maximum, up to 10 context objects, and the empty list without a deployment.

Trailhead, Configure Visit Recommendations with Next Best Action Strategy: https://trailhead.salesforce.com/content/learn/modules/visit-and-task-recommendations-for-admins-with-consumer-goods-cloud/set-up-visit-recommendations-using-nba-and-apex. Shows Strategy Builder still in current Trailhead content.
outputs: Flow-based NBA strategy that returns List<Recommendation> via an output variable
Configured Actions & Recommendations Lightning component on the target page
Recommendation sObject records with linked acceptance flows
